title: FreezePlus
description: Freeze players instantly for staff investigations — lightweight, fast, and Paper-safe.
body:
❄️ FreezePlus

FreezePlus is a lightweight moderation plugin for Paper 1.21.x that allows staff to freeze players instantly during investigations.

When a player is frozen, they are unable to move, interact, use items, or run blocked commands, and they receive a clear on-screen warning telling them to wait for staff.

FreezePlus is designed to be simple, fast, and reliable, without NMS or version-specific hacks.

✨ Features

/freeze <player> [reason]
/unfreeze <player>
/freezelist

Blocks:
movement & jumping
block breaking & placing
inventory interaction
item dropping & pickup

blocked commands
ActionBar warning for frozen players
Optional punish-on-logout system
Fully configurable messages
Paper-friendly (no NMS)
Works with LuckPerms, Essentials, and other plugins

🔐 Permissions
freezeplus.use — Use freeze commands (default: OP)
freezeplus.bypass — Cannot be frozen (default: OP)

⚙️ Requirements

Paper / Purpur server
Minecraft 1.21 – 1.21.8
Java 21

📦 Use case
FreezePlus is ideal for:
Hacker checks
Rule investigations
Saff moderation
Preventing combat-logging during checks
